_help: Rice-relative proportionality rules. RICE IS THE BASE INGREDIENT: every other ingredient defines its OWN independent relationship to rice via 'per_rice' (amount per 1 cup of rice). Recipes are independent and do NOT share parameters. Insert / modify / delete entries freely - the system picks up changes on the next request (or restart the server). Special ingredients: 'spice' (per_rice_by_spice), 'liquid' (amount = rice x rice_types[rice_type].liquid_ratio), 'protein' (per_rice grams applied to the chosen protein), 'seasoning' (normal per_rice but never scaled blindly - see note), 'to_taste' (no fixed quantity). Rounding rules: 'count' (whole items), 'half' (nearest 1/2), 'quarter' (nearest 1/4), 'range' (e.g. 2-3 tbsp when the value is fractional), 'grams' (nearest 50 g). These values are MOCKS - tune them to taste.
